description: On April 16, 2026, Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey unveiled her proposed economic development bill dubbed the “Mass Wins Act.” Filed as Bill H.5386, the Mass Wins Act proposes a number of changes to Massachusetts law to attract economic development to the Commonwealth.
paid_for_by: Paid for by The Committee to Elect Kristin Kassner
title: ICYMI: Mass Wins Act Seeks to Accelerate Housing and Development — Kristin Kassner for State Representative
